watchlist_releases.body:
## Overview

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/compare/v5.5.1...v5.5.2

## Fixed

* Modifies the workflows and docs to support the new extras branch by @ClemensSchwarke in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/242
* Keeps discounted reward history independent of caller storage by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/239
* Resumes RND exploration schedules from PPO checkpoints by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/240
* Clarifies VecEnv observation buffer lifetime by @Mikasa0503 in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/235
* Detects infinite values in environment outputs by @watayu10 in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/238
* Retains rollout remainders in mini-batch generators by @Afloat16 in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/244
* Skips singleton PPO advantage normalization by @ClemensSchwarke in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/251
* Steps CNN encoders shared by actor and critic once per update by @sxngt in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/246
* Keeps the recurrent teacher's hidden state across distillation updates by @sxngt in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/247
* Skips observation-normalizer updates for image-only CNN models by @ClemensSchwarke in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_rl/pull/252
* Fixes logging writer lifecycle and duplicate uploads by @louislelay in https://github.com/leggedrobotics/rsl_r
